verdict.rationale: Agentic search lets models explore the web, follow links autonomously and pull information from live pages (docs-41, docs-21). External tool servers and MCP tools can extend the agent (docs-4, docs-27), but no evidence shows a real browser being driven. Missing for 10: real browser automation, interactive clicking and form filling, logging in on the user's behalf, a documented browser tool or MCP integration, and hands-on corroboration.
